# Edge Cases

Orphan prose before the first card declaration should not sync as a card.

#### Empty Back

Front text with delimiter but no back content follows.

:::
<!--anki-id: 303e30db-cfbc-4b98-b50c-39e6e1bbbb3c-->




#### Declaration As Front

:::

Only the back should appear here.

The declaration line itself is the front of this card.
<!--anki-id: 0341f007-b6a8-4a39-8a5b-86ba90838d17-->




#### Normal Card After Edge Cases

What is the capital of France?

:::

Paris.

It is the largest city in France and a major European cultural center.
<!--anki-id: 174049d3-42a0-4075-9eea-9db442433267-->
